thread.title: Energous Rises On FCC Certification Of Wireless Charging Device

author: REINHARDT KRAUSE
title: Energous Rises On FCC Certification Of Wireless Charging Device
text:
Energous ( WATT ) rallied for a second day after the developer of wireless battery charging technology announced that the Federal Communications Commission has certified another transmitter in its family of devices.
X The FCC has certified a "near field transmitter" using 900 MHz radio signals, the company said in a release late Monday.
The San Jose, Calif.-based company soared 10% to close at 18.31 on the stock market today , following a 5% gain on Monday.
Shares in Energous jumped to 33.50 in intraday trading on Dec. 28 when the company announced that the FCC had certified a "mid-field" transmitter operating at a distance of three feet. Shares in Energous later swooned, retreating to 14.09 on April 3.
